title: zBuild Mechanics Registry
description: Schema for config/mechanics.yaml — the machine-readable registry of engine mechanics. A→B fallback: if a mechanic is absent from the registry, the doc generator derives documentation from its defined_in source file directly.

name.description: Unique mechanic identifier matching the docs/wiki/mechanics/<name>.md filename.

defined_in.description: Repo-relative path to the primary source file implementing this mechanic.

summary.description: One-line description of what this mechanic does.

usage.description: Brief usage note for template authors.

adr.description: ADR reference (e.g. ADR-003) governing this mechanic.
